summary: Preserved candidate PR 1451's rejection of inline/trailing DeepSeek-V4 system messages and added rejection of the independently reproduced system-only request, which otherwise reached tokenization without an assistant generation boundary.

tests.what_was_measured: Before correction, one and two leading-only system messages were accepted and rendered without <｜Assistant｜><think>; leading-system plus user rendered the boundary.

11 focused DSV4 tests passed, including trailing-system rejection, system-only rejection, multi-system-only rejection, valid leading-system plus user behavior, and serving-path rejection before tokenizer.encode.
Patch whitespace and changed Python syntax were valid.

gpu_execution.evidence: rocminfo showed one AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950, but this deterministic request-validation and pre-tokenization correction did not execute GPU kernels.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 model weights were unavailable, so the reported long-context first-token EOS and semantic model response were not replayed.
No full HTTP server was launched; the serving conversion was executed with the repository unit fixture and the common ValueError-to-HTTP-400 mapping was verified in source.
The tiny Llama transport fixture was not substituted because it cannot qualify DeepSeek-V4 prompt semantics.
